title: Sapient
summary: Self-custody Chrome extension wallet for Tari Ootle mainnet and testnets. November 11, 2026: the official Chrome Web Store offers version 0.9.6, matching the current source package, with mainnet network support and default transition. The user confirmed the wallet is live on mainnet. Use the official store for the current available extension; GitHub latest release still points to the older 0.4.2 ZIP. This audit did not install the extension or submit a wallet transfer. The retained recording is historical source footage.
cardSummary: Manage Ootle mainnet accounts, private transfers and app approvals with the Sapient browser extension.
